prediction_question: For a CPCB continuous ambient air-quality monitoring station in India, will the station's next-day (D+1) 24-hour mean PM2.5 concentration exceed 90 micrograms/m3 - the lower breakpoint of the CPCB National AQI 'Poor' band for 24-hour PM2.5 - given only that station's own hourly PM2.5 history through the end of day D?
prediction_time: 23:59 IST on day D: every hourly reading through day D is knowable at that instant and no D+1 reading exists yet. Features are the station's own trailing hourly/daily PM2.5 statistics and calendar terms only; every D+1 measurement is label source and never ships as a feature.
target_definition: Binary and mechanical from the source series: mean of the station's hourly PM2.5 values on D+1 > 90 micrograms/m3. The label source is the D+1 PM2.5 series itself, excluded from all shipped columns; the runner ships only the binary label. The threshold is a published, documented band edge (CPCB National AQI breakpoints), not a human judgement.

review: Five contracts reconciled 2026-11-05 against recorded evidence. (1) REDISTRIBUTION - supported, class A: CPCB's own publication is licensed GODL-India by the data.gov.in platform instrument (Wayback-read 2026-11-04, AIKosh-corroborated live; attribution template + non-endorsement to carry into LICENSE.md; no share-alike); the XKDR compilation is CC BY 4.0 (README, credit 'India Air Quality Database, XKDR Forum' + CPCB + US DoS); OpenAQ is CC BY 4.0 (docs + archived v2 meta 'CC BY 4.0d'). (2) PREDICTION TIMING - supported for a clearly-labelled retrospective-research scope with two declared, unverified assumptions: instant = 23:59 IST on day D; features = the station's own trailing PM2.5 history through day D (naive IST, calendar-day convention); label = calendar-day D+1 24-hr mean, entirely after the instant. Assumption (a) current-vintage: the archive is one export (2026-09-30), values 'as reported', 'no gap filling', 'preliminary and not fully validated' (XKDR README) - no operational as-of claim; revision behaviour unmeasured (a second export has never been observed). Assumption (b) day-D trailing hours are treated as complete at the instant: CPCB intraday latency is not measured (the publisher's own 4 PM bulletin averages the past 24 h and shows non-participating stations, e.g. Delhi 36/39 on 2024-11-18). (3) TARGET - supported: mechanical label (D+1 calendar-day mean > 90 ug/m3) from a published band edge of the publisher's own AQI instrument (Poor band lower edge 91; quote in measurements.threshold_fixture_2026_11_05); label-source series excluded from every shipped column; known-event fixture bound to the publisher's Daily AQI Bulletin (2024-11-18 Delhi Severe 494) AND confirmed in the measured panel (36/36 complete Delhi station-days TRUE); the bulletin is also the publisher-summary cross-check (category-level). (4) SPLIT CAPACITY - supported, measured on the full 2019-2025 panel and re-cut once with measured evidence before any score (see split_strategy): train 2019-2022 63735 positives, eval 2023 20773 positives over 357 distinct positive days, holdout 2024 19254 positives over 358 days; both classes in all three windows; winter clustering recorded and cluster-aware evaluation required at construction. (5) NOT A MIRROR - supported: novelty_check verdict differentiated (2026-10-20): research papers fit CPCB forecasters with private splits (arXiv 2404.08702 22-station; Discover AI 2026), Kaggle raw-data mirrors (CC BY-SA), and open archives (OpenAQ/XKDR/Vayuayan) - none ships this task with fixed splits and a scored contract.
